name: worklist
description: To-do sidebar next to the chat: queue tasks, even while Claude is working. When Claude is clearly done, the to-do is checked off and the next one starts; otherwise the list pauses with a reason and buttons. History per project. /todo

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

haiku.title: Haiku for unclear cases
haiku.description: When the rules can't tell whether Claude is done, worklist briefly asks Haiku (measured at about 0.05 US cents per case). Off: the list stops in those cases instead.

doneLine.title: Closing line in the to-do
doneLine.description: Appends to every sent to-do the request to end with a clear question or with "Done." (German: "Fertig."). Makes the detection more reliable.

settleSeconds.title: Settle time (seconds)
settleSeconds.description: How long worklist waits before sending the next to-do, then checks again that Claude is free.

maxAutoRun.title: To-dos in a row
maxAutoRun.description: At most this many to-dos run one after another without your input; then the list stops.
